fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the creation of a process via the Windows task manager. This might be an attempt to bypass UAC
fields.name: New Process Created Via Taskmgr.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\taskmgr.exe" and (not (tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\mmc.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\resmon.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\Taskmgr.exe"))))
